How it works

Taking bookings in three steps

No coding, no monthly SaaS fees, no sending clients to another website.

Add your services

Name, duration, price and buffer time — Haircut, 45 min, ₹500.

Add your team

Each person's hours, days off and the services they offer. Photos optional.

Publish the form

Add the Booking form block (or [rsab_booking]) to any page. Clients book themselves, 24/7.

Free forever

A booking form that feels premium

Clients pick a service and professional, then a date and time — on a real calendar that only shows days with free slots.

  • Unlimited services and staff — no caps, even on the free plan
  • “Anyone available” books the first free professional
  • Times grouped into morning, afternoon and evening
  • Booking summary and “Add to calendar” on confirmation
  • Your brand colour, your theme's fonts
Run your day

Every booking in one clear place

Summary cards for today, upcoming, waiting for approval and this month's payments, then every booking below. Confirm or cancel in one click — the client gets an email automatically.

  • Approve bookings yourself, or auto-confirm
  • Emails to the client, the staff member and you
  • Clients cancel from a secure link — no phone tag
  • Minimum notice and booking window rules

FAQ

Questions, answered

How do I install the free version?

Download the free plugin zip from this page. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, choose the zip, then Install and Activate. The setup wizard opens and walks you through your services, staff and booking page. Roohsites Appointment Booking is in the WordPress.org review queue; once it is listed there, updates arrive in your dashboard as usual.

Can you set it up for me?

Yes. Our done-for-you setup costs ₹4,999 in India or $99 elsewhere, one time, and includes the first year of Pro. We install the plugin on your WordPress site, add your services, prices, staff and hours, connect reminders and online payments, and show you how to manage bookings.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Install the plugin, add your services and staff from the WordPress dashboard, and add the Booking form block to a page. Most businesses are live in about 10 minutes.

Does it work with my theme and page builder?

Yes. The booking form is self-contained, so it looks great with any theme, and works in the block editor (as a block), Elementor, Divi and other builders (via the shortcode).

How does the free trial work?

Install Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro and start a 14-day trial — no card required. If you don't upgrade, Pro features switch off and the free booking form keeps working.

Which payment methods can my clients use?

With Razorpay: UPI, cards, netbanking and wallets (India). With Stripe: cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Or PayPal. Money goes straight to your own account — Roohsites Appointment Booking never touches it.

How do WhatsApp reminders work?

Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro connects to Meta's official WhatsApp Cloud API and sends an approved message template to your client before their appointment. SMS reminders use Twilio. Messaging fees are charged by those providers.

What happens when my license expires?

Your bookings keep working. You stop receiving updates and support until you renew — and renewals cost the same as your first year.

Can I get a refund?

Yes — if Roohsites Appointment Booking Pro isn't right for you, contact us within 14 days of purchase for a full refund. See our refund policy.
